scope: Gold-informed contextual axis-importance probe from pre-existing round-1 NPZ. No representation rebuild.
interpretation: High-variance axes are slightly stronger alone on average, while BOT axes have larger average contextual drop-loss inside the full code. However the BOT-vs-TOP contextual-importance gap is essentially unrelated to per-query SIGN-minus-float advantage. Both TOP and BOT absolute drop importance correlate positively with Delta. Thus a simple low-variance-complementarity explanation does not account for query-level LME variation; the remaining load-bearing target is joint retrieval polarity and ranking competition, not single-axis drop importance.
epistemic_note: Post-hoc and gold-informed. Mechanism-only; not deployable or causal.
